main_idea: BAR evaluates agents on end-to-end legal work: evidence, deliverable, rubric scoring.
ideas: BAR tests agents on end-to-end legal work
Evaluation runs evidence, execution, then rubric scoring
Harness changes informed by BAR raised output quality 5%
Benchmark spans 5,161 cases and 28 practice areas
Built with Legora using expert-validated rubrics
summary: The method diagram is the core, but the hero question, dataset stats, +5% band, eyebrow, tags and decorative bars clutter it; the subtitle and step descriptions are wordy; nothing essential is missing.
defects: Header logo image (e1) renders too small to read at 32px.
